scope: Measured conditional limits for unpowered fit prototype
receiving_notes: Verify measured endplay0.10..0.30 across full stroke; never use clamping screws to force an undersized gap.
Verify radial free motion with actual shaft and deburred bearing bores.
Guard face tolerance is an assembly measurement relative to original datum, not a universal printer accuracy claim.
No allowance for load-induced guard deflection; manual unpowered fit only.
